data.body: AC verification vs merged main (42cd70b889, change 1809 Verified+1/LLM-Review+1): ticked AC4-AC9 with concrete checks — tests/unit/test_mutation_confirmations.py (26 tests) + tests/integration/test_stdout_purity.py all pass on merged main; redirect golden test covers write/no-op/--quiet byte-identity and sole-stdout-result; add_dependency dict|None contract test exercises the REDIRECT path on write and no-op; comment+tag tested with --quiet and -o json incl. single-JSON-document and post-'--' safety; docs regenerated in the merged diff. THREE boxes left unticked, each for ONE unmet sub-clause (all other clauses of each verified): AC1 — per-verb exact-line tests exist, but no call-count/monkeypatch assertion on the reduce path proving no follow-up store read builds the line (the merged tests are observable-behaviour only). AC2 — no-op form/exit-0/event-count and re-link-identical-edge all asserted, but the merged change contains no inventory table classifying verbs no-op-capable vs always-writes. AC3 — zero-information-loss tests exist per normalized verb and reopen gained a line, but the merged change description summarizes rather than LISTS each old->new mapping. For the record, the mappings: create 'Created ticket <alias> (<id>): <title>'+bare-id-line -> 'created <alias> (<id>): <title>'; idea -> 'created idea <alias> (<id>): <title>'; revert 'Reverted event <u> on ticket <id>' -> 'reverted <id>: event <u>'; claim 'CLAIMED: <id> (assignee: X)' -> 'claimed <id>: open -> in_progress (assignee X)'; session-log raw JSON -> 'session-log started/appended ...'; transition 'UNBLOCKED: a,b'/'No transition needed' -> 'transitioned <id>: <from> -> <to>; unblocked: <ids|none>'/'no change: <id> already <status>'. No-op-capable: tag, untag, link, archive, transition (already-at-status); always-writes: create, idea, comment, unlink, revert, edit, set-file-impact, set-verify-commands, attach-commits, session-log, claim, reopen. Operator can judge whether these sub-clauses warrant follow-up or a tick-and-close.
